title: AI Content Systems for Local Businesses | Endless Media Solutions

facts.fact: The vendor states that its AI Integration & Content Systems service is standalone and can be hired without any other engagement.
facts.quote: This is a standalone service. You can hire us for this alone — no other engagement required.

facts.fact: The vendor states that every workflow includes a defined human review step before anything is published.
facts.quote: Every workflow includes a defined human review step before anything is published

facts.fact: The vendor states it does not promise chatbots or deep CRM automation unless the business is genuinely ready for them, and those items stay on an optional roadmap.
facts.quote: We do not promise chatbots or deep CRM automation unless the business is genuinely ready for them; those stay on the optional roadmap.

facts.fact: The vendor lists three defined scopes of work under this service: AI Content Workflow Lite, Content Intelligence Engine Pro, and Social, GBP & Content Repurposing System.
facts.quote: Not vague retainers. These are the defined scopes of work that actually ship under this service.

facts.fact: The AI Content Workflow Lite scope includes a 30/60/90-day content plan.
The Content Intelligence Engine Pro scope includes an optional Supabase/Sheets/Drive backend.
The vendor states it uses widely available AI tools and no proprietary black box, with the workflow, brand-calibrated prompts, and review process as the deliverables.
facts.quote: We use widely available tools — no proprietary black box.
